case_studies.headline: A website and social presence for a market data provider trusted since 1984
case_studies.summary: TraderMade supplies real-time and historical forex, crypto and CFD data to banks, fintechs and developers worldwide. We built their website and manage their social media — presenting four decades of market data heritage to a developer-first, API-driven audience.
case_studies.challenge: TraderMade's buyers range from developers testing an API to data teams at financial institutions. The website needed to speak to both — technical enough to earn developer trust, credible enough for enterprise procurement — and be structured so search and AI engines understand exactly what TraderMade provides.
work: Answer-first product and documentation-led content structure
Structured data and technical SEO foundations
Ongoing social media management and content

highlights.label: Years of market data heritage, told for a developer audience

case_studies.headline: A 45-page rebuild that kept every hard-won search ranking
case_studies.summary: Kingfisher House is a business centre in Bromley offering serviced offices, meeting rooms, co-working and virtual office services. We rebuilt their website from the ground up — faster, easier to update and structured for local search and AI answers — without losing the authority of the old site.
case_studies.challenge: The old site had years of indexed pages and blog articles. A redesign that changed addresses would have thrown that search authority away, and the team needed to update copy themselves without risking a broken site.
work: Full redesign and rebuild — 45 pages across services, FAQs and blog
Every legacy address preserved or redirected with a 301
Content managed in simple files, validated automatically before every deploy
Separate staging and live sites on AWS Amplify, with staging hidden from search
Service, FAQ and LocalBusiness structured data throughout
